title: Home Circle
blurb: The family members helping with this search, and what each can see.

invite.title: Add family to your circle
invite.ownHint: Find them by name or phone. They join once they accept, and help with your search from then on.
invite.joinHint: Find your son or daughter — or the person whose search you help — and say how you are related. They confirm, and you can search and send requests for them.
invite.forHint: A sibling, an aunt, a family friend who knows the families. They join once they accept.
invite.noOne: No one on ForKhatri matches that. You can type their phone number instead.
invite.joinByNumber: If {{number}} is already on ForKhatri, you can still ask to join: the request waits for them in Mangalya.
invite.inviteNumber: Not on ForKhatri yet — we will invite {{number}} by phone.
invite.joinSent: Asked {{name}}. You join their circle once they confirm.
invite.askJoin: How are you related to them?
invite.askOwn: How are they related to you?
invite.switchOwn: Adding family to your own circle instead?

pendingInvitations.title: Invitations for you
pendingInvitations.asksToJoin: {{name}} asks to join your Home Circle as your {{relationship}}
pendingInvitations.invitesYou: {{name}} invites you into their Home Circle as their {{relationship}}
pendingInvitations.addsYouTo: {{name}} invites you into {{candidate}}'s Home Circle, as {{first}}'s {{relationship}}

sent.title: Requests sent for {{name}}
sent.empty: No requests have gone out for {{name}} yet.

suggestions.title: Suggestions from your circle
suggestions.noActionTaken: Suggestion — no action has been taken on your behalf.
suggestions.noActionTakenFamily: Only a suggestion. No request has been sent for {{name}}.

members.title: Members
members.empty: No one has joined this Home Circle yet. Invite a family member to join.
members.emptyFamily: You're the only one in {{name}}'s Home Circle so far.

notes.title: Notes from family
notes.request: {{name}} wants you to read a note about this match
notes.requestExplain: You see the words only if you choose to read. Not now shares nothing, and no reason is asked.
notes.author: {{name}} ({{relationship}})

error.network: We couldn't reach Mangalya. Check your connection and try again.
error.alreadyInvited: There's already a pending invitation for that phone number or email.

contactRequests.title: Contact requests
contactRequests.ask: {{name}} wants to share your phone number with a match
contactRequests.explain: Only your phone number is shared, and only with this one match. Nothing is shared unless you approve.

family.title: Helping {{name}}
family.about: You can look for matches and send requests for {{name}}. A request goes out as {{name}}'s, with your name on it so everyone knows who sent it.
